audit.booking_engine: direct-book.com/properties/pigeoncaydirect (date and guest strip on the home page hands off to it; card held, no deposit)
audit.platform: WordPress 7.1 (WPBakery, Slider Revolution, WP Rocket), built by Hotel Traffic Builders
audit.concept_type: booking: one-page cottage site with a dates and cottage strip that hands off to their direct-book engine, eight cottages with nightly rates and galleries, getting here, weddings
must_keep: dates and guests strip handing off to direct-book.com
all eight cottages with nightly rate, sleeps and beds
published taxes and fees (VAT 10%, resort levy 6%, taxi $60 one way, breakfast $18, dinner $35)
no deposit, pay on departure policy
weaknesses: one endless page: eight cottage galleries, 18 wedding photos, 34 gallery photos and 20 FAQs in a single scroll
headline is a rotating slider of generic lines (A Taste of Paradise, Welcome to Pigeon Cay)
no deposit and pay on departure, the strongest promise, is the last line of the page
taxes, meal prices and cancellation terms hidden in pop-ups
Special Packages is a wall of promotion board terms and blackout dates
getting-here section still quotes 2016 and 2017 flight schedules and fares and shows a broken FareHarbor widget
the same guest reviews repeat, Google and TripAdvisor copies of one text
audit.note: Live WordPress one-pager with a real booking engine; record said no site. Concept keeps the booking handoff and leads with the honor system (honor bar, no deposit).
